examples.text: te santaṃ'y'eva tusitā sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, seyyathā'pi devā subhakiṇhā. ayaṃ tatiyā sukh'ūpapatti.

so imam'eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.

examples.text: cutiṃ yo vedi sattānaṃ, upapattiñ'ca sabbaso, asattaṃ sugataṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

63610.commentary: (VINa) sugatavidatthiyā'ti sugatavidatthi nāma idāni majjhimassa purisassa tisso vidatthiyo vaḍḍhakīhatthena diyaḍḍho hattho hoti.

examples.text: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā

63611.commentary: (KVt) sugat'aṅgulaṃ nāma idāni majjhimassa purimassa tīṇi aṅgulāni, tena sugat'aṅgulena aṭṭh'aṅgulaṃ vaḍḍhakihatthappamāṇan'ti attho.

tatr'idaṃ sugatassa sugatacīvarappamāṇaṃ, dīghaso nava vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ cha vidatthiyo.

63615.meaning1: preached by the Fortunate One; spoken by the Buddha

63616.meaning2: great robe of the Fortunate One

examples.text: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā

63618.meaning1: discipline of the Fortunate One; Buddha's training

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi … sammāsamādhi. ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuppannā uppajjanti, n'āññatra sugatavinayā'ti.

63619.meaningLit: discourse on the discipline of the Fortunate One

63620.meaning1: leftovers of the Fortunate One; Buddha's scraps
63620.commentary: (DNa) sugat'ātirittānī'ti tesaṃ kira bhojanāni dadamānā buddhānañ'ca buddhasāvakānañ'ca datvā pacchā avasesaṃ sāyanhasamaye denti. evam'esa sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjati nāma.

examples.text: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.

63621.meaning1: glory of the Fortunate One; legend of the Buddha
63621.commentary: (DNa) sugat'āpadānesū'ti sugatalakkhaṇesu. sugatassa sāsanasambhūtāsu tīsu sikkhāsu. kathaṃ pan'esa tattha jīvati? etassa hi cattāro paccaye dadamānā sīl'ādiguṇasampannānaṃ sambuddhānaṃ demā'ti denti, tena esa abuddho samāno buddhānaṃ niyāmitapaccaye paribhuñjanto sugat'āpadānesu jīvati nāma.

examples.text: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.

63622.meaning1: scraps of the Fortunate One; leftovers of the Buddha

examples.text: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.

63623.meaning2: dwelling place of the Buddha, imitation of the Buddha

63624.meaning1: good destination; happy fate; state of happiness

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? parisuddhattā, bhikkhave, vatthassa. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, citte asaṃkiliṭṭhe, sugati pāṭikaṅkhā.
bhagavā pana, bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṃ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti?

63625.meaning1: leading to a good destination; going to a happy fate

examples.text: idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, maggaṃ sugatigāminaṃ, nandino devalokasmiṃ, modanti kāmakāmino'ti.

63626.meaning1: bound for a good destination; destined for a happy fate

examples.text: vītikkamitabba-vatthu-samāyoge c'assa sammukhā satthāraṃ passato viya hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhāti. uttari appaṭivijjhanto pana sugatiparāyano hoti.

63627.meaning1: reaching a good destination; arriving at a good place

examples.text: ten'eva so sugatim'upecca modati, sukhapphalaṃ kariya sukhāni vindati, sam'ojasā rasaharaṇī susaṇṭhitā, idh'āgato labhati rasaggas'aggitaṃ.
gabbham'eke uppajjanti, nirayaṃ pāpakammino, saggaṃ sugatino yanti, parinibbanti anāsavā.
padumaṃ yathā kokanadaṃ sugandhaṃ, pāto siyā phullam'avītagandhaṃ, aṅgīrasaṃ passa virocamānaṃ, tapantam'ādiccam'iv'antalikkhe'ti.
idaṃ pupphaṃ idāni vaṇṇena'pi suvaṇṇaṃ, gandhena'pi sugandhaṃ, saṇṭhānena'pi susaṇṭhānaṃ. khippam'eva dubbaṇṇaṃ, duggandhaṃ, dussaṇṭhānaṃ, aniccataṃ pāpunissati.
yathā'pi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ sugandhakaṃ, evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, saphalā hoti kubbato.

63633.meaning1: good or bad smell; pleasant or unpleasant odour

63638.meaning1: well recited; well spoken; well stated

63641.meaning1: good destination; happy fate; state of happiness

examples.text: idha nandati pecca nandati, katapuñño ubhay'attha nandati, puññaṃ me katan'ti nandati, bhiyyo nandati suggatiṃ gato.

63642.meaning1: well grasped; correctly understood; well-learned; taken in the right way

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi, sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu, suggahitāni te, bhikkhu, soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni

63643.meaning1: taken hold of tightly; properly grasped; held firmly

examples.text: suṅkaghātaṃ nāma raññā ṭhapitaṃ hoti pabbatakhaṇḍe vā nadītitthe vā gāmadvāre vā, atra paviṭṭhassa suṅkaṃ gaṇhantū'ti.

63665.meaning1: (of tastes and smells) good; fine; exquisite

63673.meaning1: well practised; well performed; done correctly

jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, atho sarīram'pi jaraṃ upeti, satañ'ca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

63676.commentary: (DNa) vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī sahā'ti vepacittiasuro, sucittiasuro cā'ti ete ca asurā namuci ca māro devaputto etehi sah'eva āgato. ime asurā mahāsamuddavāsino, ayaṃ paranimmitadevalokavāsī, kasmā etehi sah'āgato'ti? acchandikattā. te'pi hi acchandikā abhabbā, ayam'pi tādiso'y'eva. tasmā dhātuso saṃsandamāno āgato.

examples.text: kālakañcā mahābhismā, asurā dānaveghasā, vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī saha.
diṭṭhā hi mayā sucittitā, sombhā dārukapillakāni vā, tantīhi ca khīlakehi ca, vinibaddhā vividhaṃ panaccakā.
gandho isīnaṃ ciradikkhitānaṃ, kāyā cuto gacchatu mālutena, sucitrapupphaṃ sirasmiṃ'va mālaṃ, gandhaṃ etaṃ paṭikaṅkhāma bhante, na h'ettha devā paṭikūlasaññinoti.

63693.meaning1: wearing clean clothes; dressed in white
63693.commentary: (SNPa) sucivasane'ti akiliṭṭhavasane. devānañ'hi kapparukkhanibbattāni vasanāni rajaṃ vā malaṃ vā na gaṇhanti. (PVa) sucivasanā'ti suvisuddhavatthanivatthā.

examples.text: ānandajāte tidasagaṇe patīte, sakkañ'ca indaṃ sucivasane ca deve, dussaṃ gahetvā atiriva thomayante, asito isi addasa divāvihāre.
tato suddhā sucivasanā, kāsik'uttamadhārinī, hasantī vimānā nikkhami, dakkhiṇāya idaṃ phalan'ti.

63694.meaning1: with beautiful mind; with a good heart
63694.commentary: (SNa) sucetaso'ti ñāṇasampayuttatāya sundaracitto. ñāṇavippayuttacittena hi sucetaso'ti na vuccati, tasmā ñāṇasampayuttena sucetaso hutvā'ti attho

examples.text: mānaṃ pahāya susamāhit'atto, sucetaso sabbadhi vippamutto, eko araññe viharaṃ appamatto, sa maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran'ti.
bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto, ākaṅkhe ce hadayass'ānupattiṃ, lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañ'ca, sucetaso anissito tadānisaṃso'ti.
